verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its own registered-agent service: its address is listed on public records, it scans incoming mail, and it handles switching RAs and filing the change with your Secretary of State. However, no evidence states that this coverage extends to every US state, or that adding a new state is handled under the same account. missing for 10: explicit all-50-state (plus DC) coverage claim, documentation of adding foreign-qualification states under one subscription, independent corroboration of multi-state use.
